import sqlite3
import requests

def sync_crm_to_reporting():
    # Fetch user data from CRM API
    crm_response = requests.get('https://internal-crm.company.local/api/users')
    users = crm_response.json()
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect('reporting.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    for user in users:
        email = user['email']
        name = user['name']
        user_id = user['id']
        
        # Insert directly into reporting table
        query = f"INSERT INTO users (email, name, crm_id) VALUES ('{email}', '{name}', {user_id})"
        cursor.execute(query)
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f'Synced {len(users)} users successfully')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sync_crm_to_reporting()
